name: CERN-PS-191
summary: PS191 was a CERN short-baseline experiment searching for heavy neutral-lepton decays and studying electron-flavour events in a neutrino beam from the Proton Synchrotron.
physics_targets: Heavy neutral-lepton mixing with electron and muon flavours
detection_principle: A decay region downstream of the production target was instrumented with tracking and electromagnetic-shower identification. Candidate charged tracks and electron pairs tested hypothetical neutral-lepton decays, with neutrino interactions serving as an additional signal and background channel.

results.summary: Set improved limits on hypothetical heavy-neutrino couplings to ordinary neutrino flavours; the reported electron-like anomaly was not a confirmed oscillation discovery.
